summary: Full-stack E2E validation of HomeCare Indonesia. Backend: created pytest suite (57 tests) covering auth/RBAC, nakes setup, admin verification, provider search + haversine/distance/rating filters, order lifecycle, chat, SOAP medical record, mock QRIS payment, admin payment verification, commission/income math, reviews, notifications, admin stats — 57/57 passed. Separately probed authorization boundaries with a second patient/nakes: 7 checks failed (cross-tenant IDOR + no login rate limiting). Frontend: completed the full 3-role UI journey (landing -> register nakes -> profile/lat-lng/online/service/document -> admin verify -> register patient -> search -> book (shadcn calendar+time) -> chat both ways -> nakes accept + SOAP submit -> patient QRIS pay -> review 4 stars -> view/print medical record -> admin verify payment (Lunas) -> nakes income Rp179.775 = 211.500 - 15% commission, rating 4 ★, admin stats/omzet updated). Notifications bell shows unread counts for order/verification/record/payment events. Mobile (390px) and desktop layouts render correctly.

critical.endpoint: GET /api/orders/{oid}, PUT /api/orders/{oid}/respond, PUT /api/orders/{oid}/complete, POST /api/orders/{oid}/medical-record, POST /api/orders/{oid}/payment, GET|POST /api/orders/{oid}/chat, GET /api/orders/{oid}/medical-record
critical.issue: IDOR / missing ownership checks: any authenticated patient can read AND pay another patient's order; any verified/unverified nakes can accept, reject, complete and write the SOAP medical record for an order that belongs to a different nakes; any logged-in user can read/post to another order's chat and read its medical record (PHI leak). Verified with 2nd patient + 2nd nakes accounts — all returned 200 instead of 403/404.
No brute-force protection/lockout: 7 consecutive wrong-password attempts on admin@homecare.id all returned 401, no 429 or account lock.

minor.issue: Unguarded: if the payment's order row is missing, `pat = db.patients.find_one({'id': o['patient_id']})` dereferences o=None -> 500. Add a None check.
Review allowed regardless of order status (no check that order is completed/paid) and by any patient (see IDOR).
Duplicate offerings for the same service_id can be added repeatedly (no uniqueness), which yields duplicate provider cards in search.
No password strength/length validation on the backend (frontend only enforces minLength=6).
Assumes db.nakes doc exists for the user (nak['id']) — would 500 for a nakes user whose profile row is missing; guard with 404.

ui_bugs.issue: Editable rating stars are bare <svg> with onClick — not focusable/keyboard accessible and had no test id (added data-testid=star-1..5 during testing).

design_issues.screen: Patient Profil (Tanggal Lahir) and Nakes Dokumen Legal (Berlaku Sampai)
issues: Use the browser-default native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used in the booking dialog — inconsistent UX and non-Indonesian date format
No Google OAuth button, while the Login page has one — inconsistent sign-up options
Nakes without a filled profile show generic 'Tenaga Kesehatan' and 0 rating with no 'baru' indicator; duplicate service offerings would render duplicate cards

action_items: CRITICAL: add ownership/authorization checks on all /api/orders/{oid}/* endpoints (order belongs to the calling patient, or to the calling nakes) and on chat + medical-record read endpoints.
HIGH: add login rate limiting / lockout after ~5 failed attempts.
Guard verify_payment against a missing order document (currently 500-prone).
Restrict review creation to the order's own patient and to completed orders; prevent duplicate nakes_services rows per service.
Replace native date inputs in Patient Profil and Nakes Dokumen Legal with the shadcn Calendar component; add the Google button to the Register page (or remove from Login for consistency).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (784 lines) is a single monolith — split into routers (auth, nakes, orders, payments, admin) before it grows further.
get_current_user only authenticates; there is no per-resource authorization helper. Introduce e.g. `async def get_owned_order(oid, user)` used by every order sub-route.
respond_order/complete_order accept any nakes token and silently update by id — this is the main data-integrity risk.
PatientDashboard.jsx is 502 lines with dialogs inline; consider extracting Booking/Payment/Review/Record dialogs.
Chat has no polling/websocket — messages only refresh when the dialog reopens (acceptable for MVP, worth noting).
seed_data_creation: Backend suite creates TEST_-prefixed users per run (test_pat_*/test_nak_*, test_p1/p2/n1/n2 for the authz probe) plus one TEST layanan. UI accounts: pasien_ui26a@example.com / nakes_ui26a@example.com (password Passw0rd!) with a completed+paid+reviewed order.
test_credentials: Admin admin@homecare.id / admin123 (works). UI test accounts: pasien_ui26a@example.com and nakes_ui26a@example.com, password Passw0rd!
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run functional suite with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -n 0 -q` — the suite shares session state across classes so xdist loadscope (default addopts -n 2) breaks it; -n 0 is required. tests/test_authz_probe.py documents the 7 expected-to-fail authorization/rate-limit gaps; re-run it after the main agent adds ownership checks and all 7 should pass. Frontend flows fully verified end-to-end; if retesting UI, note admin nav keys are ringkasan/verifikasi/transaksi/layanan/pasien and booking requires a future date (calendar disables past days).
rca_of_the_issue: All order/chat/medical-record/payment routes look documents up by id only (db.orders.find_one({'id': oid})) after a role check, never comparing the resource's patient_id/nakes_id with the caller's profile id. Reproduce: register 2 patients + 2 nakes, create an order with patient A/nakes A, then call PUT /api/orders/{id}/respond with nakes B's token -> 200 and the order status changes. Mitigation: resolve the caller's patient/nakes profile id and require it to match the order before mutating/reading.
